note: Additional CIS-derived checks beyond the agent's built-in set. Import via Admin → Content Packs → Import pack. Validate per engine before relying on them.

checks.title: Symbolic links are disabled (have_symlink)
checks.remediation: Add symbolic-links=0 to my.cnf and restart — prevents table-file redirection attacks.

checks.title: SHUTDOWN privilege limited to admins
checks.query: SELECT user, host FROM mysql.user WHERE Shutdown_priv='Y' AND user NOT IN ('root','mysql.sys','mysql.session','mysql.infoschema')
checks.remediation: REVOKE SHUTDOWN ON *.* FROM '<u>'@'<h>'; — SHUTDOWN can stop the server.

checks.title: CREATE USER privilege limited
checks.query: SELECT user, host FROM mysql.user WHERE Create_user_priv='Y' AND user NOT IN ('root','mysql.sys','mysql.session','mysql.infoschema')

checks.title: RELOAD privilege limited
checks.query: SELECT user, host FROM mysql.user WHERE Reload_priv='Y' AND user NOT IN ('root','mysql.sys','mysql.session','mysql.infoschema')

checks.title: log_error_verbosity is not 'terse'
checks.remediation: Set log_error_verbosity='default' (or 'verbose') so errors carry enough context.

checks.title: 'contained database authentication' is disabled
checks.query: SELECT CAST(value_in_use AS INT) v FROM sys.configurations WHERE name='contained database authentication'
checks.remediation: EXEC sp_configure 'contained database authentication',0; RECONFIGURE; (unless contained DBs are required).

checks.title: No user database has TRUSTWORTHY on
checks.query: SELECT name FROM sys.databases WHERE is_trustworthy_on=1 AND name<>'msdb'
checks.remediation: ALTER DATABASE [<db>] SET TRUSTWORTHY OFF; — TRUSTWORTHY enables privilege escalation paths.

checks.title: O7_DICTIONARY_ACCESSIBILITY is FALSE
checks.query: SELECT value FROM v$parameter WHERE name='O7_DICTIONARY_ACCESSIBILITY'
checks.remediation: ALTER SYSTEM SET O7_DICTIONARY_ACCESSIBILITY=FALSE SCOPE=SPFILE; — keeps SYS dictionary out of ANY-privilege reach.

checks.title: audit_sys_operations is TRUE
checks.query: SELECT value FROM v$parameter WHERE name='audit_sys_operations'
checks.remediation: ALTER SYSTEM SET audit_sys_operations=TRUE SCOPE=SPFILE; — audits SYSDBA/SYSOPER actions.

checks.title: DEFAULT profile sets a PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION
checks.query: SELECT limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE profile='DEFAULT' AND resource_name='PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION'
checks.remediation: ALTER PROFILE DEFAULT LIMIT PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION <fn>; — enforce password complexity.
